scene.speaker: oliver
scene.bubble: Last month I broke my arm skating. A week in hospital… and the whole team visited me every single day!
scene.intro: Last month Oliver broke his arm skating. First they took an X-ray, then the doctor put his arm in plaster, and he stayed in hospital for one night. Two days later everybody visited him with comics, and a week later he was playing the guitar with one hand — badly, but happily. The nurse said he was the noisiest patient of the year. What happened to YOU last year? Tell it in order!

data.text: On Monday I fell while I was skating and broke my arm. At the hospital they took an X-ray — I saw a photo of my own bones! The nurse, Miss Elena, was the kindest person there. On Wednesday the whole team visited me: Ingrid brought a huge card, Maya brought a science comic, and Diego interviewed the doctor for his news show. Kili sat on my window every morning. On Sunday I went home with a blue cast on my arm — and fourteen signatures on it!

It's called Broken Arm Blues. … Oliver: The doctor said I was very brave when they took the X-ray. … Oliver: And when I went home, the team was waiting with a banner that said WELCOME BACK!
